PURE HARMONY.
Press your G80’s accelerator pedal, and the response of its turbocharged
engine and electronically controlled 8-speed transmission pushes you firmly
into the driver’s seat. Two new G80 engines are offered for 2021: A powerful
375-hp 3.5L V6 twin-turbo and a 300-hp 2.5L I4 turbo3 – the most potent
4-cylinder engine in its class.4 Traction is also offered with two options: Rear
Wheel Drive or available All Wheel Drive.
Reach for the rotary gear selection knob on the center console, and the
knurled textures engraved around the edge of its tempered glass are sure
to make an impression. As you shift from Park into Drive or Reverse, the
dial’s illumination changes color.
A rigid steel body structure clad with lightweight aluminum hood, door and
trunk panels improves the G80’s power-to-weight ratio. The less weight an
engine needs to move, the more agile those movements become. A faster
steering ratio adds to the G80’s precise handling reflexes, while a new electric
brake booster amplifies your car’s stopping power.
